name: dashboard-design
description: Design and build dashboards and admin panels people can actually read: a clear layout and navigation, the few numbers that matter on top, charts and tables that fit the data, filters, and loading, empty and error states, checked on desktop and phone. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for real app screens and design systems from real SaaS websites.

interface.longDescription: Design and build dashboards and admin panels people can actually read: a clear layout and navigation, the few numbers that matter on top, charts and tables that fit the data, filters, and loading, empty and error states, checked on desktop and phone. The skills work on their own. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for real app screens and design systems from real SaaS websites.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Find design systems from real SaaS websites for a dark analytics dashboard.
positive.prompt: Find design systems from real SaaS websites for a dark analytics dashboard.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a few real SaaS design systems with dark themes, with their colors, typography and a DESIGN.md.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Build an analytics dashboard for my SaaS in React and Tailwind, styled from a real SaaS design system.
positive.prompt: Build an analytics dashboard for my SaaS in React and Tailwind, styled from a real SaaS design system.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a real SaaS design system from UXKIN, then builds the dashboard with key numbers on top, charts and tables, and loading, empty and error states.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Show me real app screens of dashboards with charts and key numbers.
positive.prompt: Show me real app screens of dashboards with charts and key numbers.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real dashboard screens from UXKIN and points out what makes each one easy to read.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Review my admin panel and compare it with real SaaS products.
positive.prompt: Review my admin panel and compare it with real SaaS products.
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the user's admin panel with real products and lists what to fix, most important first.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Find a clean design system from a real website to style my internal tool.
positive.prompt: Find a clean design system from a real website to style my internal tool.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns real website design systems that suit an internal tool, with a DESIGN.md to apply.

publication.release_notes: First release in ChatGPT and Codex. Three skills: dashboard-layout, data-display and dashboard-review, plus the UXKIN connection for real app screens and design systems from real SaaS websites.
